verdict.rationale: WorkOS is API-first, so it can be driven programmatically without a UI. Evidence includes official server SDKs (Node, and Python with an async client), a published OpenAPI spec, API-based role configuration, and SDK auto-retry with backoff, all of which suit unattended scripts. A WorkOS CLI migrations tool also exists, but nothing documents running the product non-interactively in CI pipelines. CLI Auth is a device-flow feature for customers' own apps and is not credited here. missing for 10: documented CI/headless usage guidance, a general-purpose non-interactive WorkOS CLI with API-key auth for pipelines, independent or hands-on corroboration of automation use.
